==Stats==
: [[Slashing damage]]: 9-21 (Requires 4 [[Scythe Mastery]])
: [[Damage]] +15% (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])

: [[Energy regeneration]] -1
: [[Health]] +20
: Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Razorclaw Scythe]].
